items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: If you had to list a few of the trumpet players that influenced you pretty strongly in your formative years, who would they be? ... Clifford Brown.

ctx.x: If you had to list a few of the trumpet players that influenced you pretty strongly in your formative years, who would they be?
Well Harry James and Roy Eldridge and Dizzy Gillespie, Miles Davis, Chet Baker, Clifford Brown.
